source_metadata.title: StagedWorkspace: A Versioned Workspace for Knowledge-Work Agents
source_metadata.design: knowledge-work agent systems study with matched mechanism ablations and non-paired complete-system benchmark comparisons

extraction_limitations: Extraction is grounded in arXiv v1 as submitted 2026-08-18; no later revision is represented.
Complete-system leaderboard comparisons were retained only as non-paired contextual results and tagged accordingly; causal interpretation is reserved for matched ablations.
Review-axis findings come from a 57-task file-editing subset and should not be generalized to the full APEX benchmark without further study.

The extraction preserves operational appendix details that affect provenance, freshness, review, and reproducibility, but it does not atomize every grader-prompt or low-level implementation parameter.
No independent reproduction of the authors' benchmark runs or planned code release was performed.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated system-architecture or benchmark-configuration atom kinds; these source-supported assertions are represented as method, qualitative_result, limitation, or other supported kinds.
